content:
maya: MicroBurst Labs EAP kickoff — NDA signed, need to align benchmarks, telemetry & announcement window. cc @liam @sunita @jordan @nicole. Plan to run perf suite week of Mar 7. Thoughts?

liam: I can own benchmarks. Need lab credentials and hardware details (firmware, driver). Any perf targets? :eyes:

sunita: We'll want KV-cache warmups, 8k sequence tests, and a small real-world prompt mix. Please include FP16 baseline + INT8 quant runs. Tokenization sanity + accuracy smoke too.

jordan: Solutions can prepare example marketplace packaging + an integration demo for partners. Do we need a lightweight Helm chart or a marketplace image tarball?

nicole: NDA is attached (signed by MicroBurst legal). Legal flags: no public announcement until 30 days after the final report is delivered. Also need to approve any joint messaging copy ahead of time.

maya: Uploading the NDA to the shared folder now. Tentative embargo: 2026-03-20 (can adjust if run slips). MicroBurst also requested a CSV of run-by-run numbers + short explainer for each test.

liam: Good. I'll run a quick smoke today against their alpha image to validate environment. @bench-bot please queue job mbl-alpha-run-1 with bench-suite v2.3

bench-bot: Job queued: mbl-alpha-run-1. Estimated runtime: 2h. Logs will be posted to /bench/results/2012345678-mbl-alpha-run-1

liam: Command I used for reference:

```
./run_bench.sh --image microburst/alpha:2026-02 --suite default --seq-len 8192 --batch 1 --out /bench/results/mbl-alpha-run-1
```

sunita: Add these acceptance criteria to the run: throughput within 15% of our internal baseline, p95 latency < 100ms on 8k, and int8 quality delta < 1% on our eval set.

jordan: For marketplace packaging let's lean toward an OCI image + a short install script. Field teams prefer 1-click deploys.

maya: Scheduling check-in: Thu 11:00am PT for a 30m sync. If that works I'll send a calendar invite. @jordan @liam @sunita

jordan: Works for me. :thumbsup:

nicole: Legal to confirm embargo window tomorrow. Also assign a liaison for pre-release copy review.

maya: I'll be liaison for partner comms; @nicole will handle legal review. We'll coordinate blog draft once final numbers land.

bench-bot: Job complete: mbl-alpha-run-1
Summary: FP16 throughput 122 tok/s, INT8 throughput 150 tok/s, p95 latency 82ms (8k seq). No crashes. Full logs: /bench/results/2012345678-mbl-alpha-run-1/summary.json

liam: Nice. I'll upload CSV summary and a quick slide deck for the partner. Putting preliminary numbers into the shared spreadsheet.

sunita: Will run accuracy eval overnight and post results in the thread.

maya: Great progress — thanks everyone. We should mute any public comms until legal signs off. I'll keep the group posted.
